name: Area 47
kurzbeschreibung: Europe's ultimate outdoor adventure park at the entrance to the Ötztal offers the Water AREA, giant slides, rafting, and canyoning.
preis: Water AREA day ticket adults from approx. €31.00; outdoor adventure tours booked separately
oeffnungszeiten: Open daily from early May to early October from 10:00 to 19:00
beschreibung:
Overview

The internationally famed Area 47 at the gateway to Tyrol's Ötztal is Europe's largest and most exhilarating outdoor adventure park for action sports, water fun, and extreme experiences. Spanning over 9.5 hectares at the confluence of the Ötztaler Ache and the River Inn at an altitude of 700 meters, this premier recreation arena was created for adrenaline seekers, sports groups, corporate teams, and adventurous families. The focal point of the expansive grounds is the iconic 'Water AREA', boasting a 20,000-square-meter swimming lake, high-speed mega waterslides, a freestyle ski jump slip'n'slide, and the thrilling 'blobbing' catapult cushion. The innovative concept seamlessly merges pristine alpine river scenery with cutting-edge sporting infrastructure, offering professionally guided whitewater rafting and canyoning expeditions.

Route & Requirements

The grounds of Area 47 cater to a broad spectrum of fitness and experience levels. Visiting the bathing lake, sunbathing lawns, and beach volleyball courts is relaxed and accessible without special prior knowledge. However, taking on the high-adrenaline attractions – such as the 27-meter-high aerial adventure ropes course suspended beneath a highway bridge, the giant 'Mega Swing', or the cliff-diving platform – requires absolute freedom from vertigo, solid physical fitness, and steady nerves. Confident swimming ability is mandatory in the Water AREA, while age and weight limits apply to extreme slides and blobbing. For guided rafting and canyoning, complete neoprene and safety gear is provided. Dining options range from lakeside terrace dining to a hearty steakhouse.

Visit & Arrival

The summer season at Area 47 runs from early May to early October; the Water AREA opens daily from 10:00 to 19:00 (extended during peak summer). Day passes and guided tour tickets are available online. Motorists travel via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Ötztal) directly to the signposted main car park beside the Ötztaler federal road. Arriving by rail is convenient: Ötztal-Bahnhof train station is only two kilometers away, connected by shuttle buses, rental bikes, or a pleasant twenty-minute walk.

Tips

Try the legendary 'blobbing', where the impact of a second jumper launching onto an enormous inflatable cushion catapults you high into the air before splashing down into the lake. Book a guided introductory whitewater rafting tour through the picturesque Imster Schlucht gorge for an unforgettable adventure.
